articles.headline: Spain reports first personal data breach linked to an AI agent
articles.summary: Spain’s data protection watchdog said it received the first reported notification of a personal data breach allegedly carried out by an AI agent. The case is a warning for companies adopting autonomous systems, because it raises direct compliance, governance, and incident-response risks around agentic AI.

articles.headline: AI stocks slide as cybersecurity names rally on slowdown fears
articles.summary: Tech stocks tied to the AI buildout fell while cybersecurity shares jumped, signaling a possible shift in enterprise spending priorities. For businesses, that points to continued pressure on AI infrastructure vendors and stronger near-term demand for security tools as boards reassess risk and budgets.

articles.headline: Investors rotate into cybersecurity after AI spending slowdown warnings
articles.summary: Market coverage on September 15 said concerns about AI spending momentum pushed down chip and memory names while cybersecurity stocks rose. That matters for enterprises because it suggests capital may shift away from some AI infrastructure plans and toward security, compliance, and resilience spending.
